claim_policy.established: Local data-asset advantages include scale, explicit WT/variant disposition, evidence tiers, observation lineage, assay modality, and automation fields.
claim_policy.not_established: Predictive superiority over any comparator remains untested on matched frozen splits.
claim_policy.nr: Not recoverable from a primary source or official artifact during this audit; never an estimate.

models.split: 80/20 scaffold plus random/scaffold fivefold CV; external-I maximum train similarity below 0.3
models.method: XGBoost AutoML over 62 fingerprints/descriptors and 30 pretrained representations
models.critical_audit: Pretrained representations were not consistently superior; external-II is tiny and assay/WT semantics are absent.

models.split: random 80/20 plus deliberately balanced 100-compound external panel
models.method: 2048-bit Morgan fingerprint fused with a four-layer 64-head task-trained Transformer
models.critical_audit: Paper counts differ by 11; random split and balanced tiny external panel limit deployment inference; encoder is not a pretrained molecular language model.

models.split: official SI training/internal/Ogura external partition; ISE-selected strata cover 64 percent
models.method: 29 balanced XGBoost base learners plus isometric stratified ensemble mapping
models.critical_audit: The best result excludes 36 percent of external compounds; internal data informed both ISE mapping and descriptor selection.

models.task: binary hERG blockade with docking features
models.method: ClassyPose docking, PLEC fingerprints, RF/XGBoost/DNN bases, DNN stack
models.critical_audit: Only 0.646 percent active; docking pose/conformation dependency and public-screening semantics differ from a WT functional benchmark.

models.split: curated internal development plus independent 706-compound external set
models.critical_audit: External R2 is modest and error worsens markedly away from the dense 10-micromolar region.
High positive prevalence and random split ease the task; current repository metrics do not match the paper version.

models.split: repository fixed random test fold plus rotating validation folds
models.method: five fingerprints, descriptors, molecular graph, and co-attention
models.critical_audit: Released training code evaluates the fixed test every epoch and saves best-test checkpoints; repair before benchmarking.

models.split: paper fivefold CV; repository also contains fixed 80/20 code path
models.method: byte-level BPE SMILES Transformer, fingerprints, and layer-wise self-adaptive GAT
models.critical_audit: Empty test sheet, hard-coded absolute paths, and missing generated features prevent clean end-to-end reproduction.

models.task: multimodal hERG, Nav1.5, and Cav1.2 classification
models.split: repository random development partition plus 60/70 external sets
models.method: SMILES, graph/structure, and fingerprint contrastive fusion
models.critical_audit: Secondary channels are small; repository has absolute paths and no detected license; no explicit WT or assay-protocol semantics.

models.task: semisupervised hERG, Nav1.5, and Cav1.2 classification
models.split: channel-specific external hERG-60/hERG-70 and analogous sets
models.method: semisupervised random forest/self-training with fingerprints and descriptors
models.critical_audit: Unlabeled scale is not labeled evidence and assay/WT semantics remain limited.

models.method: mixture of experts over CDDD, descriptors, ChemBERTa, and Morgan
models.critical_audit: A useful transfer adapter, not a direct WT-hERG benchmark; endpoint evidence semantics differ.

models.method: fingerprints, 20 descriptors, ChemBERTa-384, predicted L1000-978, eight heads
models.critical_audit: v1.0 had 12 tan70 and 15 tan60 train-to-validation cliff-cluster violations, corrected in v1.1; training loaders/caches remain incomplete.

models.split: large held-out partition; not the proposed scaffold/source protocol
models.method: RF, SVM, XGBoost, DNN, GRU-DNN, and GNN
models.critical_audit: Large and relevant but pooled HTS labels and non-source/non-scaffold split do not establish new-chemistry generalization.

models.task: few-shot cross-assay bioactivity adaptation; not hERG-specific
models.method: pairwise meta-learning/foundation model for assay incompatibility
models.critical_audit: Potential pretraining adapter only; hERG value must be established on frozen local splits.

models.task: censored quantitative regression and uncertainty; not hERG-specific
models.method: Tobit/censored negative log-likelihood and censored-MSE adapters
models.critical_audit: Appropriate relation-aware loss adapter only when enough true censoring exists; it does not justify fabricating point values.
